parameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY image 1: silver-haired Moon Shadow assassin run/NE/07. Output one whole character on genuine transparent background, native 1254 x 1254 RGBA PNG. Image 2 is the bamboo archer run/NE/07, ONLY a northeast/upper-right-away camera projection reference for the coordinated hips, knees, ankles and heel-to-toe yaw. Never copy her identity/clothes/weapon or her left/right leg phase. Image 3 is corrected Moon Shadow NE/10 direction sample, identity and northeast boot yaw reference ONLY; do not duplicate its knee bends, support phase or exact foot placements. Image 4 is the major approved hand-painted style and material reference, no UI.
Precise correction below the waist ONLY: the original lower body and planted boot are too straight-back NORTH. Paint a coherent rear three-quarter NORTHEAST/right-front-away projection: turn pelvis/knees/ankles and both whole boots toward screen-right and away, like image 2. The planted low boot must clearly show its side plane with toe to screen-RIGHT and away from its heel, heel to the LEFT/rear; no straight-back heel-only NORTH projection and no leftward toe. The raised foot must keep its sole facing back as in the original phase but its ankle and boot yaw must follow the same northeast direction.
PHASE AND POSITION LOCK: keep the LARGE LOW EXTENDED LEG/BOOT on SCREEN-LEFT/near-centre at its original landing position, and keep the SMALL RAISED BENT LEG/BOOT on SCREEN-RIGHT with its visible sole. Do NOT swap feet, move the support foot to the other side, lower the raised foot or change to a different stride. Change only anatomical yaw/projection, retain original knee bend, lift and support roles.
Preserve everything above the pelvis from image 1: silver bob and hair ornament, exact back/face visibility, navy scarf silhouette, arms/hands, both crescent daggers in original hands and locations, torso and belt accessories. Retain navy pants, navy/gold crescent boots, chibi proportions, subject scale and whole canvas framing. No crop/zoom/recentre/mirror, no new shadow, no green clothes/bow/text. Refined bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painted finish. One unchanged 75 ms slot of the existing 16-frame 1200 ms animation.
FRAME-SPECIFIC POSITION/PHASE OVERRIDES: Keep the low extended foot near 47% width / 93% height with its existing push-off tilt and partial sole exposure. Keep the raised foot at screen-right near 66% width / 77% height. Make the low toe point right-front-away, with coherent hip/knee/ankle yaw; do not shift foot positions or change which leg is raised.
CRITICAL: preserve image 1's LOW FOOT PITCH and partial sole exposure. Its rear heel is raised; it is NOT a flat planted shoe. Rotate ONLY its left/right YAW to point right-front-away. Show the original dark sole under the raised heel on the lower-left side, while the toe is screen-right. Do not give it a horizontal flat sole, do not set heel and toe on the same baseline. Image 3 corrected NE06 is a direction/pitch example; keep exact NE07 limb placement.
